title: Root-module plugins match sink bootstrap and cannot compile
claim: The SQL, command, and JSON bootstrap selectors match a root-module package main with test-main false but do not exclude -buildmode=plugin. The full configured integration set therefore attempts to inject SQL bootstrap into a plugin, contradicting README.md:88-90, and the valid plugin build fails while resolving github.com/DataDog/dd-iast-go/iast/database/sql with a NATS maximum-payload error; the paired plain Go plugin build succeeds.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/hooks-scope-root/scopefixtures/workspace/app && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go build -buildmode=plugin -gcflags=all=-l -o ../app-plugin.so ./cmd/plugin

title: README leaves the module boundary of application root ambiguous
claim: Direct propagation is scoped to the single Go module resolved from Orchestrion's current working directory, not an entire go.work workspace. A sibling workspace module selected by replace remains uninstrumented for direct propagation, and vendoring preserves that boundary, while README describes only an application root.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/hooks-scope-root/scopefixtures/workspace/app && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go build -gcflags=all=-l -o ../app-from-member ./cmd/app && go tool objdump -s example.com/dep.Upper ../app-from-member
